claims.text: Mapping the world share of residents aged 65 or older
claims.support: Population ages 65 and above as a percentage of the total population.

claims.text: A visualization of the percentage of the population aged 65 and over across 208 countries and territories in 2025.
In Japan, 30% of all residents are aged 65 or older.
Dark blue is lowest, grey-gold is middle, and bright yellow is highest. We have data for 208 countries and territories.
Japan is the world's highest at 30%, while Qatar is the world's lowest at 2%.
claims.support: Japan rank 1 with 30%, Qatar rank 208 with 2%

claims.text: The USA sits at 18%, while India is currently at 7%.
This measures the percentage of the total population aged 65 and above, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
claims.support: Definition: Population ages 65 and above as a percentage of the total population. Population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
